terms.relation: (unsigned int)fd < ctx->nr_user_files must hold to fall through past the if (unlikely((unsigned int)fd >= ctx->nr_user_files)) goto out; branch and reach the fixed-file lookup
ctx->nr_user_files > 0, set by a prior io_sqe_files_register() incrementing nr_user_files once per registered slot
ctx->file_data must be non-NULL, i.e. files were registered via a prior successful io_sqe_files_register()
ctx->file_table must be allocated (via io_alloc_file_tables in prior io_sqe_files_register())
the submitted fd parameter must align with the registered-file index space: 0 <= fd < the nr_args count registered by the prior io_sqe_files_register()
